game.title: Dark Fantasy Settlement
game.tagline: Raise a frontier town, staff it with heroes, and push back the fog.
nav.label: Main navigation
slot.head: Head
world.pan_hint_web: Drag to pan · scroll, pinch or use the buttons to zoom · tap a zone to open it
world.special_area: Special area. No settlement can be founded here.
world.settlement_preview: Claiming founds a new settlement here, shaped by its biome.
settlement.dismantle_confirm_body: Its workers go idle and four-fifths of everything it cost comes back.
recruit.locked: Build a Veil Tavern in any owned settlement to unlock the Recruit market.
recruit.empty: No heroes are currently waiting. Refresh the market to draw a new slate.
recruit.gems_locked: Raise a tavern to level 3 to draw gem-priced heroes.
heroes.intro: All recruited heroes are gathered here.
heroes.empty: No heroes recruited yet. Build a Veil Tavern to unlock Recruit, or use the Debug menu.
hero.unavailable: That hero is no longer available in the roster.
hero.name: Name
hero.pick_slot: Choose a slot to see the gear that fits it.
hero.no_matching: No inventory equipment matches this slot.
hero.dismiss_warning: Dismiss this hero permanently? Assignments, world tasks, and equipment links will be cleared.
inventory.intro: Recovered supplies, relics, and equipment are stored here for later use.
inventory.no_items: No items have been recovered yet.
inventory.no_equipment: No equipment has been recovered yet.
craft.smithy_level: Highest smithy level: {level}. Upgrade a smithy to unlock more recipes.
craft.sort_hint: Press again to reverse the level order
craft.quality_note: Where the piece lands in each range depends on the forge: every miss lowers the ceiling.
puzzle.keys: Keys: Space to start, strike or pump · arrows to stoke, vent or nudge
puzzle.crafted: Forged: {name}. It is in your inventory.
puzzle.timing_strike.title: Timing Strike
puzzle.timing_strike.help: Watch the circle move across the bar. Press Strike when its centre is inside the red zone. Land 3 clean strikes before {max} misses.
puzzle.timing_strike.miss: Glancing blow. Wait for the hot zone.
puzzle.heat_balance.title: Heat Balance
puzzle.heat_balance.help: Keep the forge heat inside the safe centre band. Use Stoke and Vent to control it. Hold it for four seconds before {max} misses.
puzzle.bellows_rhythm.title: Bellows Rhythm
puzzle.bellows_rhythm.help: Pump the bellows when the marker passes through the red beat window. Five good pumps before {max} misses.
puzzle.bellows_rhythm.off: Off rhythm. Wait for the beat.
puzzle.bellows_rhythm.missed: Missed beat. Pump inside the red window.
puzzle.edge_sharpening.title: Edge Sharpening
puzzle.edge_sharpening.help: Keep the bright marker balanced around the centre lane. If it drifts left, nudge right; if it drifts right, nudge left. Hold for four seconds before {max} misses.
save.confirm_save_body: Whatever is in that slot now is overwritten, and this game saves there from now on.
save.confirm_save_body_active: This game's slot is saved automatically too; this saves it now.
save.failed: The browser refused to save. Storage may be full or disabled.

debug.intro: Use these tools to accelerate testing and UI verification.
debug.resources_text: Adds 100000 of every tracked resource immediately.
debug.recruit_text: Generates and recruits a random hero without Tavern or cost requirements.
debug.xp_text: Adds 100 experience to every recruited hero.
debug.equipment_text: Adds 10 random equipment instances to inventory.
save.description: Autosave runs during play. Manual saves, renaming, and reset are available per slot.
settlement.choose_structure: Choose a structure to raise on this plot.
settlement.no_available_heroes: Recruit heroes at a Veil Tavern to expand your roster.
world.no_available_heroes: No idle heroes are available for this clearing party.
world.pan_hint: Drag empty space to pan the world map. Use the mouse wheel to zoom.
away.title: While you were away
away.duration: You were gone {hours} h {minutes} min. The settlement carried on.
away.capped: Only the first {hours} hours were simulated; past that, the settlement waited for you.
hero.broken_help: Sanity ran out. Only the Chapel can take this hero until their sanity is whole again.
hero.wounded_help: Health ran out in battle. Only the Triage can take this hero until they are fully healed.
hero.skills_intro: Every {heroClass} learns these passive skills as they level. They work on their own.
log.detail.recruit: A survivor heads for the tavern: +1 recruit
recruit.free_refresh: The slate renews itself for free in
save.export_hint: Saves live in this browser only. Export one to keep a copy that survives clearing site data, or to move a game to another device.
save.import_failed: That file is not a Dark Fantasy Settlement save.
settlement.effect_triage: Heals {heal} health per patient per tick, for {gold} gold each.
settlement.effect_chapel: Restores {amount} sanity per hero per tick. Broken heroes can only rest here.
settlement.effect_barracks: Trains {amount} XP per hero per tick.
settlement.no_shaken: No heroes need the Chapel's quiet.
world.pick_party: Pick a party to see its odds.
world.win_chance: Estimated chance of victory: {chance}%  ·  Sanity -{sanity} each
hero.same_as_worn: Identical to the piece worn now.
settings.sound_on_hint: Music and effects. The speaker button in the top bar does the same.
settings.toasts_hint: Victories, defeats, level-ups and broken heroes. Everything still goes to the Log.
settings.away_hint: What happened while the game was closed or the tab was hidden.
settings.mist_hint: Animate the fog over the map. Starts off if your device asks for reduced motion.
settings.autosave_hint: How often the game saves while you play. It also saves when you leave the page.
settings.debug_hint: Testing tools: free resources, instant heroes.
settings.data_hint: Settings and saves are kept in this browser only. Export a save from the Save Vault to keep a copy.
settings.reset_warning: Sound, notices, map and saving go back to their defaults. Your saves are not touched.
settings.wipe_warning: Every save slot on this browser is deleted, settings are reset, and the game starts over. Exported save files are not affected. This cannot be undone.
